team_id_help.label: How do I find my team ID?
team_id_help.step_1: Open the FPL site and go to your Points page.
team_id_help.step_2: Copy the URL from your browser's address bar.
team_id_help.step_3: Your team ID is the number right after /entry/.
team_id_help.id_note: That number is your team ID.
